🫧 Foam Parties

Foam Parties

Turn your backyard into a foam wonderland! Our cannon fills a massive 30×40 ft area up to 5 feet high — kids absolutely love it.

Everything Included
  • 60 minutes of non-stop foam
  • Two professionally trained operators
  • Music provided
  • Beach balls & noodles included
  • Cannon fills 30×40 ft area, 5 feet high!
